10110010.t: Hideout
On a quiet, lazy day...
No work today... and those freeloaders are out, so...
...Ahem...
[Exclusive: Panoticon Management Handover Complete... Internal Promotion Likely]
Already? Man, that Head Maid really knows how to get things done.
[In-Depth: How the Vermont Ethics Committee's Chase Code Is Affecting Adult Films]
So that's what Valentina was so mad about... Guess I should buy her a drink next time.
[Next article... Our editor-in-chief never does any work. Let's see if anyone even checks this.]
...? What's this?
[Feature: Lingerie Fashion Show Coming This Winter... Famous Designers Join the Lineup! Model Auditions Now Open.]
A lingerie show, huh... Like that [Luxury Lingerie] from before? And they've got famous designers on board, too.
These are... pretty revealing... Ahem... They're practically naked.
Whoever designed these is a saint... Let's see... Er... mina...?
Trick or treat! Enjoying the festival, my friend?!
?! Wh-What the!?
What do you mean, "what"? It's Halloween! Hal-lo-ween!
The day the boundaries blur. We celebrate it with a festival.
Exactly! The festival's in full swing, so why are you hiding away in your room... Oh...
Ahem... Well, looks like you had your own little festival going on in here. Mm-hmm.
...So full of energy. You must be healthy.
Get out, you two!!!
...So. What do you want?
Ahaha! Well, the Halloween festival has begun in Quartet!
Do you know what Halloween is?
Of course I do!
...What is it, then?
...Uh... Well...
Isn't it a festival where you dress up in costumes and play naughty pranks?
Ahahaha! Exactly! That's what I like to hear, my friend!
Then what is it?! Go ask anyone outside! Most of them would tell you the same thing!
And why are you barging in here to quiz me?! I was trying to enjoy a little peace and quiet!
...Sorry about that.
Haha, fair enough. No need to get so worked up, my friend.
I've got some good news for you, too...
...Oho? What, you've got a job for me?
Just so you know, I don't lift a finger unless the pay is good.
Payment? How cold! Is that all I mean to you, my friend?
And what exactly are we to each other?
...What are you to each other?
Hmm...
We've shared something precious, haven't we?
Something... precious...
Wait, you've got the wrong idea.
You never gave me anything.
...Why?
I didn't give her anything! Do you even know what she's talking about?
What? Don't tell me you forgot! *Sob*... Did that promise mean nothing to you? Was it all just a fling?
What promise are you even talking about?! Wait... Don't tell me...
You mean when we said we'd get drinks a while back?!
Haha! You finally remembered, my friend!
Then just say that! You nearly gave her the wrong idea! Did you see the look in her eyes?!
...A promise to drink.
Yeah! We just said we'd have a drink together. I got hold of some good whiskey and traded it for some of Dan Xi's traditional liquor.
I see...
Yeah, so...
You never made that promise to me.
Why would I promise to drink with you?! You can't even handle your booze!
But...
I want to have a drink with you too, <:player>.
Geez, fine, fine. Come with Dan Xi next time we have a drink.
Anyway, get to the point. What's going on with Halloween?
Well, my friend... Do you know what the Fairwinds Association actually does?
A bunch of slackers waxing poetic all day?
Indeed! Slackers drifting like wind and clouds, waxing poetic... Wait, what?! M-My friend, is that really what you think of me?
How rude. Maybe Dan Xi is, but not me.
Kouchou! That doesn't describe me either! I'm a martial artist serving the Fairwinds Association, you know!
Yeah, right. I found you passed out drunk in an alley the other day. You'd have wound up in the donut house if I hadn't come along.
A-Ahem! I-I am grateful for that, of course.
Anyway, the Fairwinds Association's main job is to run Quartet's daily festivals...
What, so you just get to slack off and have fun? Sounds easy.
Indeed. Partying and lazing around day after day, never tiring of it...
Wait! Stop twisting my words, my friend!
I couldn't help it. Your reactions are priceless.
!?  Good grief, you really are hopeless.
...I'll take it from here.
<:player>, do you know why the Orchid Clan hosts a festival every day?
Hmm... I feel like I've heard about it somewhere...
Maybe they just really, really love festivals? Total festival fanatics?
*Sigh.*
!? What? Did Kouchou just sigh at me?!
Ahaha! You should try giving a serious answer, my friend!
Ugh... Is it to make money, then? Is Quartet secretly broke?
...The Orchid Clan hosts the festivals. They're the wealthiest of the four clans.
Then what the heck is it?!
In Quartet, we fight to keep the corrupting power from spreading.
To drive it back, we need people's purifying energy.
That's why we hold festivals. To keep everyone happy.
Corrupting power?
Indeed. It's a power born of "things" that shouldn't exist.
If it takes hold of you, you gradually change... until you become "the same" as them.
It's the duty of Quartet's four clans to keep that from happening.
Oh... That actually sounds pretty legit...
So you guys weren't just useless slackers after all?
In any case, we fight to protect the festival from that corruption.
And we came to see you because...
...you need my help, right?
Sharp as ever, my friend! No need to spell it out!
Exactly. The Fairwinds Association needs your help protecting the festival.
Well, I get that. But here's the thing...
You know I don't work for free, right?
Of course. I know you all too well. If you help us...
...Can't you just help us?
Ugh... You're playing that card?
You never had a drink with me, <:player>.
...Unfair.
I'd do anything you asked without expecting anything in return, <:player>.
...Anything?
Yeah.
...Anything.
Well, when you put it like that... how can I say no?
All right, let's see what we're dealing with. I'll worry about my payment later...

10110020.t: Sky Lantern Street
...The corrupting power has grown stronger.
Hmph, so it seems.
Wh-What are those things?
As I said, the corruption is spreading.
They're even roaming the city now... What are the guards doing?
Those are aberrant spirits... Remnants that slipped through the Rift.
Leave them alone, and they'll cause trouble.
Trouble? What kind of trouble?
Huh, my shoulders feel really heavy today...
That's what happens when you've got those ridiculously huge things on your chest.
What? Just admit you're jealous.
I'm perfectly fine as I am, thank you very much!
Sure you are. Is that why you were secretly trying on my chest wraps last night?
Ack?! Y-You were awake?! You sneak...!
Heheh! So what if I was?
H-Hey... You're not actually mad, are you?
...Give it to me.
Huh? Wh-What did you say?
Give it... to me... Your... precious... thing...
Eek! W-Wait...! I was only joking! Besides, I can't give you this!
I just want us to be friends...!
Fri... end...?
Yes, friends!
Fri...end...
Friends... delicious...
Eek!?
Give me... more... Your feelings... Your... [■■■]...
N-Not theeeere—!?
Whoa, this is that kind of festival? You should've told me sooner.
No, it's not.
Whew... The corruption has already spread this far into the festival.
I'll cleanse the corruption for now.
Huh?! Wh-What did I just do...
Haa... Haa...♡
I just wanted us to be friends...! That was supposed to be enough...! Waaahhh!!
Ah! W-Wait...! Honestly, it felt kind of good...!
...So getting possessed by an aberrant spirit makes you super horny or something?
Haha, close, but not quite. They feed on "emotions," "urges," "memories," and "thoughts." Everything in the mind that makes up a person's Origin.
They eat... your mind? That's creepy.
Once an aberrant spirit has consumed enough mental energy, it can take physical form. That's when things get complicated...
Still, a minor spirit won't do any serious harm if it only latches on briefly, like that. No need to worry too much.
Though they might have trouble keeping their feelings or urges in check for a while...
Ugh, this place is already full of people who can't control themselves...
So why do they possess people in the first place?
Because they exist beyond the boundary.
They're always longing for "something" they can't feel or find there.
So that's why they cross over?
Exactly! Quick on the uptake as always, my friend!
Hey, I can't breathe! Let go! Not that I mind, but... You're squeezing too hard... *Cough!*
Dan Xi, let go. Keep that up and <:player> will become an aberrant spirit.
Oops! R-Right. Though you might be rather fun as an aberrant spirit, my friend.
Whew... That was almost death by boobs.
Death by boobs...
If only mine were a little bigger.
Hey, don't get jealous! Are you trying to kill me too?
Yours look great as they are. Don't worry about it.
...Hmph.
Okay, so these aberrant spirits are hungry for all sorts of things, and they're ruining the festival. But...
What do we do about them? Exorcise every last one, like Kouchou just did?
Well, about that...
We'll have to shut down the Halloween festival and exterminate the aberrant spirits.
Whoa, where did that come from?!
I'm told Halloween began as a festival honoring the dead.
This is the time when the boundary between the living and the dead is at its weakest...
Holding a festival at a time like this... What is the Orchid Clan thinking?
Surely you know the Orchid Clan holds festivals all year round?
As for what they were thinking, well...
They were thinking of partying!
How can you say that so proudly?!
...Very well. I'd already factored in your shamelessness, Lady Dan Xi.
Oho...? Which means...
Yes. The Fairwinds Association's duty is to "protect the festival"...
So I knew you wouldn't back down, even now.
Then the Umbral Watch will simply do its job.
You... Yes, you could certainly handle the aberrant spirits.
One of the Moonshadow Wardens' finest. Hehe... Now this is getting interesting.
...It's been a while, <:player>. Have you been well?
My, am I invisible?
<:player>. Kage is right. Aberrant spirits have overrun the festival. It's dangerous here.
For your own safety, please leave this matter to me.
That's not happening.
<:player> promised to protect the festival with us.
...Outsiders should stay out of this.
A-A promise...? Outsiders...?
I can't accept being called an outsider.
I may not be the strongest, but I'm one of the Moonshadow Wardens. Purging aberrant spirits is our duty.
With so many running rampant, I can't just stand by.
...What will you do, <:player>?
<:player>... Whose side are you on?
What?! Why am I suddenly the one who has to choose?!

10110030.t:
Haha, quite the dilemma, my friend.
Perhaps you should have behaved yourself a little better!

Now this is my fault?
Dammit, what did I even do?

<:player>...
I still remember the time we spent together.
Back then... <:player>, you caressed my most intimate place and said...
You couldn't wait to see me grow stronger... to discover passion...
I've never forgotten that promise. Not for a moment.
...You made me a promise, too.
While you were rubbing my thighs so roughly... you promised I could stay by your side.
Do you remember... that promise?
(Guh...! How am I supposed to choose...!?)
Choose Chise

Heh...
I knew you'd make the right choice, <:player>.
Come, let's go.

...You're leaving?
Even though you promised me...

That power... Is that...?
I see. The boundary is collapsing.

It is surely no ordinary power, but...
Even if only for your sake, <:player>, I will not back down.
Choose Kouchou
Yes. Of course you'd choose me.
You two can leave now.

...How could this be...
<:player>... What of the promise you made to me...
Hmph. Our promise came first...
No, mine came first...!
Choose Dan Xi
I... choose this one!
Huh? Me?

Got a problem with that, you flat-chested brats?
Okay, neither of you is actually that flat, but...
Anyway, I'm warning you: start fighting, and you won't see me for a month.

...You can't do that.
And... they're not small.

...That would be rather upsetting...
And mine aren't that small, either...
Quiet! If it bothers you that much, come back when yours are this big!

Anyway!
Quit fighting over nothing and let's get this job done!

You both want to deal with the aberrant spirits, right?
You just disagree about whether to cancel the festival.

True. The Umbral Watch and Moonshadow Wardens put purging aberrant spirits and protecting Quartet first. Of course they'd want to cancel.
I do understand their position...

And we understand why the Fairwinds Association wants to protect the festival.
It does help suppress the corrupting power...

But we can't let aberrant spirits run rampant through Quartet.
Not when it's the Chrysanthemum Clan's duty to purge them.

Then there's our answer.
As long as we get rid of the aberrant spirits, it doesn't matter how, right?
Of course. But they're appearing too quickly for us to purify them one at a time.

Hmm... That's true.
Even with Kouchou and me fighting, there are far too many of them.

But we have an ace up our sleeve.
Namely...

If you say it's me, you'll be playing fighting games with me for three straight days.
And I'll teabag you every time I win.

!? M-My friend.
That's... Haa...♡

Looks like I guessed right.
No wonder you agreed to my terms so easily...

Hehe... Isn't that what you do best?
I know you'll find a way out of this, my friend.

Tch.
Fine, whatever.
Kage, do you have to put your plan into action right this second?

Not necessarily.
But the longer we wait, the worse the corruption will get.

For now, it's limited to the festival. But if we leave it unchecked...
It'll spread throughout Quartet.
If that happens, we will end up repeating the tragedy of the past.
Hmm...
I won't let that happen.

The boundary is thin, but it's still holding.
I've been protecting it all this time.

These aberrant spirits...
They're different. Something's drawing them here.

Drawn to something...?
What is it?

...I don't know.
I haven't figured that out yet.
Ugh...
Well, isn't that why you came to me?
Kage, if your plan can wait, why not give us a little time?
If we fail, we'll let you know right away.
If that's the case...
If we succeed, the aberrant spirits leave and everyone's happy. If we fail, you'll have time to get a backup plan ready.
Isn't that what you do best?

Heh... You never fail to surprise me, <:player>.
You've done it again.

Very well. If it's your plan...
I may have my doubts, but I'll trust you.
You okay with that too, Chise?
...If that is your wish, <:player>...
Hyah...?!

Don't look so disappointed.
I'll get rid of the aberrant spirits, then come play with you too.

Keep yourself warmed up for me.
Got it?

Haa... Understood.
I'll be... looking forward to it♡

All right, then... Now let's go sort this out—
Wait, what?
You left me out again.

!?
Fine, fine! I'll give you the same treatment!

Ngh...!
Haah...

She's being pretty bold today, isn't she?
Did something happen?

Who knows?
Hehe... Perhaps she just missed your touch, my friend?

Still, well done, my friend.
That could have turned ugly, but you handled it beautifully.
We nearly started fighting each other before we even dealt with the aberrant spirits!

Tch...
As if that wasn't exactly why you called me.

Anyway, just lead the way.
If we can't solve the problem, Kage's going to step in again, right?
Right!. Let's take a look around the festival.

10110040.t: ...Phew.
Haha, there really is no end to them!

They just keep coming!
Shouldn't we try Kage's plan?

Hmm? Giving up already?
That isn't like you, my friend.
Ugh, quit talking like that and say something actually helpful for once.
I mean... wasn't something drawing the aberrant spirits here? Shouldn't we look for that?

Perhaps.
But Sky Lantern Street is enormous. Where would we even start?
It'd be like looking for a needle in a haystack.
Gah...
...I can't keep this up much longer.

I could do this all day, but...
There are so many aberrant spirits, some are bound to get through.
And the corrupting power they leave behind is drawing even more of them here...

Well, well! Looks like you've got a little festival of your own over here!
*Hic!*

But why keep pouring water into a cracked jar?
Hehe...

Hiyori?!
You came to help us?

Nope. I just came to drink.
...*Hic!*
Hehe, want a drink?

Of course you did...
Can't you see we're dealing with aberrant spirits?! This is no time for a drink!

Ehehe, don't give me that look.
It's a festival! You're supposed to have fun!

Besides, I only just woke up!
This is my first bottle! My first!
That just means you're slightly less drunk than usual!!
Don't sweat the small stuff!

Hang on... You, over there...
Hmm...
...What?

No, I mean... you.
You've got something pretty wild bottled up in there, don't you?
Bwahaha! I've met plenty of crazies, but I haven't met one like you in ages!

Wow! How do you live with all that bottled up?
I'd have jumped him by now! Ehehe, humans are a riot!
And as for you...
Heh...
You're strong, aren't you?

Hiyori, First Sword of the Four Seasons...?
So we finally meet in person.
That ominous aura... You're no ordinary martial artist.

Oho...!
You can actually sense that?

Hahaha! What a nice surprise!
Festivals really are the best!

Ah, what a shame.
If things were a little different...
We could have a match right here.

Hehe, I'd be happy to spar anytime.
But right now... I have something else to take care of.

Ehehe, fair enough!
Good luck with all that!
Say, do you like festivals?

Festivals?
You bet I do!
Great food, great booze, and so much to see!

Hehe, is that so?
Then you might have a problem.
This one might be shutting down soon.
W-What?!

That can't happen!
I haven't even finished my first bottle yet!!!
I haven't even picked up the free booze they give members of The Four Seasons yet!!
...It might, unless we can get these aberrant spirits under control.

Well, we can't have that, can we?!
Ngh... Guess I've got no choice.
Oh, you're gonna help us?
Hah! Don't you know me by now?
You really think I'd draw my sword over this?
Of course not, you drunkard.

Kyahaha! Exactly!
You know me so well.
Drawing my blade on these things wouldn't even be fun!
Still, it'd be a shame to shut the festival down.
So... how about I give you a little tip?
Hey, shrine maiden! Can you put up a barrier?
...A basic one, yes.

Ehehe, that's all we need.
Just make sure the aberrant spirits can't get out.

All you've been doing is taking down aberrant spirits.
That's never going to work.
The trick is to keep the 'corruption' from spreading. Got it?
Put up a barrier so the aberrant spirits can't slip away... like this!

Hehe, no need for a sword with small fry like these!
My bare hands will do just fine.
Anyway, do it like this, and the aberrant spirits will—

Ah, geez... Still too early for this, huh...?
Hmm...

?
What is?
Yahaha! Never mind. Just thinking out loud.

Anyway! Cut off their supply of mental energy, and they vanish.
Well, really, they just return to the 'other side'!
So... as long as we put up a barrier and keep them from spreading, they'll disappear on their own?

Exactly!
The corrupting power stays contained, and the corruption can't spread!
Hmm... But who's gonna do it?

Huh?
You guys, obviously...
If Kouchou handles the barrier, won't Dan Xi have to fight all those aberrant spirits alone?

Mmm... You'll figure it out, Mr. Fixer!
Bye!
Hey, hey! Are you really just walking away?!
I mean, thanks for the tip, but...
Kouchou, would that actually work?
...Yes.
Aberrant spirits gradually burn themselves out and disappear, leaving corrupting power behind.
A barrier would keep them from escaping and stop the corrupting power from spreading.
But that would leave Dan Xi to fight them alone.
Hmm... It's possible, but I doubt I could hold them all off.
There are so many. It would take a while.
So we need more people?

...I'd need at least two people
to help me keep the barrier up.
Really? Does it matter who?

No. I'll perform the ritual.
They just need to stand beside me and lend me their strength.

All right.
In that case...

?
Who are you calling?

I know someone who's probably slacking off right now.
Might as well put her to work.

Hello? Ah, is this the Hundred Schools of Thought?
I'd like to report one of your teachers...

10110050.t: Ferry Landing
Ahh, nothing beats a lazy day at the Ferry Landing!
No one nagging me, no research papers due!
Now, for a nice, relaxing bit of fishing...
Hey! How many times do I have to call before you pick up?!
Ah! <:player>, hello, hello! ☆
"Hello" my foot! Why is getting you to answer your phone a boss fight?!
Huh? You called? ...Whoa, that's a ton of missed calls!
Yeah! What were you even doing?!
Me? <bouten>Slacking off</bouten>, obviously! And a little fishing on the side!
Yeah, I figured. That's why I came all the way out here.
You know me so well!
Well, too bad. I've got a job for you.
W-What?! I only just got here to relax!
Oh, really? Finished all your work, have you?
...Y-Yeah. P-Probably...?
Turned in your research paper?
Finished your grading?
...Hehe.
Hello, Hundred Schools of Thought? I've found one of your teachers playing hooky...

Waaah! Wait, wait! W-What do you want?! My next paper?! A research partnership?! Second author credit?!
Or... d-don't tell me!
That's right, <bouten>your body</bouten>—!
...is what you thought I'd say. Nope.
I-Is that so? Ahaha!
All right, explain it to her.

Aberrant spirits are overrunning the festival.
The Fairwinds Association can't handle it alone.

R-Really...? But I'm with the Hundred Schools of Thought. I'm not much use in a fight.
Wouldn't the Moonshadow Wardens be a better choice...?

We'd have asked them if we could.
I called earlier, but they're busy with aberrant spirits on the outskirts.
At this point, I'd take help from a cat.
Well, why don't you go ask a cat, then...?
That cat is you.

Agh, you're really not letting me out of this!
I just want a break!
You? You're always slacking off and cutting corners!
Keep whining and I might just turn you into a cat...
...Will you let me off if I act like one?

Not a chance.
Give it up and get to work, you wage slave!!

<:player> is right. We need all the help we can get.
Won't you lend us a hand?
I'll treat you to some fine wine once it's over.

...Mmm... If it's a request from Dan Xi...
But... Aberrant Spirits…?
Are you scared?

S-S-S-Scared?! Who's scared?! Not me!
I'm a scholar of the Hundred Schools of Thought! Theory, logic, philosophy, thought—those are my specialties!
As if I'd be scared of some illogical, unscientific, unverifiable, irreproducible supernatural phenomenon!

They're proving they exist and reproducing right in front of us...
Honestly.

All right, then.
Let me tell you the best way to beat fear.
W-What is it...?
The most effective way to overcome fear is...

...to give yourself something even scarier to worry about.
Ever heard of the threshold effect?

...There you are, Hari.
I checked every classroom. So this is where you've been hiding.
W-Well, you see, it's a very complicated situation...
Oh, I'm sure. It must be quite something if you skipped your lectures, student advising, and faculty meetings to hide out here.

Ah, ugh...
U-Um... you see...
Yes?
Eep...
Are you... mad at me?
What do you think, you lazy excuse for a teacher?!
Waaaaah!
A moment later...

...I'll help.
Actually... please let me help...
Yeah, that's the spirit.
You sold me out, didn't you...?

Sold you out? How hurtful.
Call it a strategic transaction.
Someone had to tell your colleague. Maybe a little pressure will finally get you to do your job.

Thank you for letting me know.
May I ask your name...?

I'm <:player>.
I work as a fixer in Humanitas.

Ah, I've heard a great deal about you.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
I'm Jia. A colleague of this slacker here.

She's already missed today's classes, so there's no fixing that...
But a little community service might at least save the Hundred Schools of Thought some embarrassment.
Work her to the bone. Teach her to pull her own weight.
Oho...
Oh, I will! I'll drill that sense of duty and responsibility right into her!
...You demon! Monster! Pervert! Heartless, cold-blooded beast...!
Haha, stop. You're making me blush.
It's not a compliment!!
Still, you're not scared of the aberrant spirits anymore, are you?
Of course not! After that horror show, aberrant spirits are a walk in the park!

Sob... I'll get you for this!
If not in this life, then from beyond the grave!
People hardly ever die here! What are you even talking about?

Hey, Jia!
Your colleague is spouting nonsense again!

Gah! Fine, I get it! Can we just go?
Any more nagging and my heart's going to give out...
...Huh?
...Huh?

We're all going together.
You, me, everyone... and her.
Aberrant spirits aren't just a problem for the Moonshadow Wardens and the Fairwinds Association.
A responsible teacher should take the initiative and set an example.
...And I'll be keeping an eye on you. Don't even think about slipping away.
Ugh...
Waaaaah!!

10110060.t: Sky Lantern Street
I see. No wonder you came to us for help.Hundred Schools of Thought
All right, let's make this quick! ☆
Wow, you bounced back fast. Feeling better already?
...Could you not? I'm trying to cheer myself up here! Just thinking about keeping that barrier up wears me out!
Haha, people call the Hundred Schools of Thought a bunch of stuffy scholars, but there's more to them than that.
So, how about a sparring match once we're done?
No thanks! I have a strict policy against unnecessary work!
I'm not interested in fighting, and I'm definitely not doing it!
Dan Xi. We're only using our strength because Quartet needs us.
We're not here for fun, or to see who's stronger. Please understand that.
Is that so? Hmm... What a shame.
I suppose I'll have to take out my frustration on the aberrant spirits, then.
...Please do.
At this rate, we should get rid of the aberrant spirits before the festival has to close.
Oh my... That would be rather troublesome...

Who's that? ...Hang on. That's quite an outfit.
Is that your Halloween costume?
Hehe... It's a one-of-a-kind outfit I put together with the children for our outing...
It's been so long since our last outing, so I must make sure to show proper respect...
...Isn't that a little revealing for a day out with the kids?
Hehe... This is the only way I can give the children a warm embrace...
Hmm... By the way, you're quite cute yourself...

So...
Won't you become [our] child...?

Child? What the hell—
Mmph!!!

Mmmph...?
Mmm...

Fufu...
Such a handsy child, aren't you...

It's all right...
You can touch me as much as you like...

Body and mind...
Leave everything to us...

Your Mother is...
right here...

Ugh...
Wait... what...?
<:player>!!

Whoa?!
What the...

Oh my...
What a pity...

You...
This presence is...
The guide of the spirits... Here?

Specter of the boundary...
Get your hands off my subject.
...Phew, nice save.
Wait, you're still doing that bit?

It's not a bit.
But more importantly...
W-What is this...

You belong to neither side...
Poor child...

How much pain...
how much sorrow must you have endured...

I'm the Shrine Maiden of the Boundary.
This is nothing to me.

I won't tell you again, specter.
Back away.

Shrine Maiden of the Boundary...
Ah... there was such a thing, wasn't there...

A pawn...
to put our children to rest...

...I told you not to come any closer.
What are you trying to do?

Who can say... I only wish to draw out...
the drive deep within...

With a drive this powerful... our children won't need to venture out...
for quite some time...

Come now... you're a good child, aren't you...?
Come to Mother...
...Did you want a mother that badly?

No, I didn't!
Where did that come from?!

I mean, s-sure, I took one look and thought, "Now that's mommy material!"
But still...

No...
The guide of the aberrant spirits goes by many names, like Mother of Aberrant Spirits or Ghost Mama, but...

"Mommy"...?
I haven't heard that one before...

Ah, forget about that!
So, what the heck is she, anyway?!

...She has no name.
For convenience, Vermont calls her "Shade", and Quartet calls her "Ghost Shadow".

For decades, she was little more than an urban legend. There were barely any sightings...
This is the first time I've seen her myself...

Shade is easier to say...
Anyway.
Well, a mommy who brainwashes, corrupts, and hypnotizes you against your will is a first for me...
...Did you get brainwashed and corrupted?

I said no!
We're never going to get anywhere at this rate.

Anyway, you!
What are you doing here?!
...I only came to see...
The new [Star]...

Ah, O Star.
Grant us new life as well...
A new light to fill this void that feels so utterly hollow...
Get back, <:player>!
Ngh...!
Kouchou!
My, what a brave child...

Just what I'd expect from a shrine maiden...
Such courage. Such determination...

But that's quite all right...
Our children aren't picky eaters...
And it won't be their first taste of a shrine maiden's [■■■]…

Ah...
Aaah...!
Ah...
Mmh...

Such dense energy...
I simply must let more of the children taste this...
Is it because the star has drawn closer, I wonder...? The flavor is even more concentrated… and feels all the more intense...

It's all right...
Don't be afraid...

Ah... Haa...!
N-Ngh...!

Don't resist... Share all of yourself...
with us...

Haah...
N-no...

This is my...!
My precious... Aaah...!
Ah... I can feel it. All the agony, the sorrow, the pain you've endured...

Child of the Boundary. Half on one side, half on the other...
It must have hurt so much...
You don't have to bear it alone anymore... Come to this side... There'll be no "you" or "us" anymore. We'll all be "the same"...
No...! <:player>!!

Dammit...!
Here goes nothing!!

10110070.t:
Ngh...!
Aaaah...!!
...T-This power is...?!

Hey, Kouchou!!!
Snap out of it!!

Haa, haa...!
I c-can't hold on...!
Aaargh!!

...You pushed us back...?
What is this power...?

Let... go of my hand...
<:player>! You'll get caught in this too...!
Shut up!
It looks like it's working for now, so hold on tight!
We can worry about the rest later!!

That's...
Ngh...!

My friend, what's wrong?!
What's going... Hm?
...You are...
Tch...!
Gah...!
How dare you hurt my friend!
I am Dan Xi of the Fairwinds Association. My goodwill extends to all under heaven, but I won't forgive anyone who disrupts a festival or harms my friends.

You...
You're hardly a child, are you...

Even among us...
A presence as vast as yours is rare indeed...

Of course.
I'm an adult, after all.
W-Why are you looking at me like that, my friend...?
Nothing. Just wondering how someone like you counts as an adult...

This was supposed to be my big heroic moment!
Don't you think you're being a little harsh?!

Then you should've saved us sooner!
Did those huge boobs slow you down or what?!
W-What a scandalous thing to say!

I'm not slow!
Even the Umbral Watch has to work up a sweat to catch me!
That's the part you're mad about?!

That's enough of an outing for today...
Come along, everyone. Time to go home...
Our home, the land granted to us, the place where we belong... To our place of exile, filled with nothing but chaos and void...
Whew... I sensed a strange presence and came to see what was happening...
More importantly, are you all right, <:player>?

I'm fine.
Kouchou, on the other hand...
Kouchou, are you all right?!

The aberrant spirits got her.
It looked like they sucked something right out of her...
...It doesn't look like she's down for the count.

But I've never seen convulsions like this...
What happened to her?

Ngh...
Aaah...!

This... is different.
Her power is overflowing...? If this goes on...
If this goes on, what?!

Too much is worse than too little.
A river overflowing its banks will sweep away everything in its wake.

We need something to hold her power back...
A talisman, perhaps, but...
And you don't have one, right?
Then where can we get one?!

There's no way.
We can't find one at such short notice...

Of course, one person who might be able to help does come to mind...
Though she is quite the elusive sort—
Hehe, did someone call for me?

Whoa! You scared me!
Where did you come from?!

Anytime, anywhere...
A shadowy merchant appears, offering her wares only to worthy customers.

Yomi of the Blissful Trading Guild, at your service!
Let's do business!
I always have just what you need, so do forgive a little price gouging! Hehe...

?!
Yomi! Is that really you?!
You couldn't have picked a better time or place to show up!

Hehe... Who knows?
Let's call it fate!
...Fate or not, just do something already!
Dan Xi will cover the bill!
Eeeek?!
Oh, give me a moment! I only just got here!
But this doesn't look like the time to haggle! Let's see...

Ah...
Haah...♡

Hehe... My, this spot's sensitive...
Hold still, Kouchou.

B-But...
Haah...! Aahn...!
Wait, I thought she was in pain. Is she just pent-up?

Of course not.
Yomi's checking how the energy is flowing through her body.

Mmm... Let's see.
What about here? And here...?

Aha... Hah...!
Mmm...!
...Yeah, she looks pretty pent-up to me.
Surely she's only reacting that way because her body's so sensitive... right?
There! Just as I thought. Two different powers are clashing inside her!
The aberrant spirits made her corrupting power stronger, but there's another, completely unknown power making things worse!

What do you mean?
The aberrant spirits weren't the only cause?
Oh, their corrupt aura definitely started it!
But it's like they stirred up a hornet's nest! This unknown power is spreading through Kouchou, changing her body however it pleases!
Almost like... it's waking something that's been asleep for a very long time...

Skip the part none of us understands.
What do we do?

For now...
Hup!

Ngh...
Haa, haa...
The talisman has calmed her power down. She'll be fine for a little while!
Whew... So she's okay now?
Nope!
What? You just said you fixed it!

It's only a temporary fix!
Like building a flimsy dam across a river!

It might hold for a few days...
Or it might suddenly go boom! and burst!
Then we have to act before it does.
That's right! But this is tied to Kouchou's constitution, so it'll take a bit of preparation, you see?

To properly control Kouchou's energy...
it has to be a place where the energy of [this side] and [the other side] meets!
This side and... that side?

Yes. A "boundary" between the two.
And in Quartet, that would be...

The Northern Shrine.
It's known for its many Rifts...
Bingo!

You'd better hurry! Kouchou's power keeps getting stronger...
There's no telling how long that talisman will last.

All right, straight to the Northern Shrine...
Wait.
Then what about the festival?

Ah... That's a problem.
We can't just leave the festival unprotected...
In that case, please leave the festival to us.
Hah!
...We heard what happened.

I had originally intended to show <:player> my thoroughly warmed body, but...
it seems now is not the time.

Hmph... Quite the predicament.
Of course, I knew you'd run into trouble...
W-What...?! You already knew we'd meet a weirdo controlling aberrant spirits, Kouchou's power would go haywire, and we'd need to take her to the Northern Shrine?!

O-Of course.
I anticipated that as well.
(That's a total lie.)
(Definitely a lie!)
(Shh... She's taking the bait.)

Then you knew we'd need someone to protect the festival while we're gone, right?
And you've already got a plan for that, haven't you?!
A-A plan...
You do have a plan... right?!

R-Right...!
I... think so...?

Great! We'll leave it to you!
Come on, everyone!

A-Ah! Wait a second!
Don't tell me just Chise and I have to handle this huge festival...?!

The Hundred Schools of Thought folks are here, too! Put them to work!
I'm counting on that plan of yours, Kage!

H-Hmm...
Well, if <:player> says so...
Then I have no choice. I'll protect the festival with my flawless plan!
(Too easy.)

10110071.t: For a long time, I walked the boundary.

A place between worlds, belonging to neither side.
Between being and nothingness, virtue and corruption, yin and yang, life and death.
I'd never been able to fit in with people.
A few approached me with kindness...
But far more treated me like a monster, then left.

When had it started...?
When had I begun pushing people away first?

It hurt to turn people away.
So I kept my distance, before anyone could get close.

The only things that never changed...
were the butterflies.
They'd been with me for as long as I could remember.
But they weren't companions I could truly connect with...
And so I remained alone.

The loneliness hurt...
But I couldn't abandon my duty as the Shrine Maiden of the Boundary.
I knew what would happen if I did.

So I rarely left the shrine.
I only went down to the village when I needed supplies.
Whenever I visited, the village was alive with festivities.
I watched all those smiling faces pass me by.
All I did was watch.
On and on...
What a dull way to live.
Who...?

Just a wanderer, drifting with the wind and clouds.
Though now that I have a job, perhaps I need a new introduction!
...If you have no business with me, leave me alone.
Hehe, business? Of course I do.

I'm Dan Xi, a guest of the Orchid Clan...
And a warrior of the Fairwinds Association. I protect the festival.
So when I see someone looking miserable at a festival, of course I want to know why.
I'm not miserable.
Really? You looked rather envious to me...

I've never envied them.
Don't put words in my mouth.
Then perhaps I was mistaken.

Still...
You don't seem to be enjoying the festival.

Festivals...
I hate them.
...I don't see what's so fun about them, either.

Hmm, fair enough.
They are rather loud and crowded.

Exactly.
So...
But how can you know until you've tried it yourself?

I've wandered the world for a long time...
And there's still so much I don't know.

So perhaps...
It's a little early to make up your mind.
Heh, to be honest, someone said the same thing to me not long ago.

I'm sure you have your reasons for keeping people away.
You tried to push me away, too.
How do you know that?
...Because I used to be the same way.

I wandered for a long time.
Wherever my feet took me, wherever my heart led.

I didn't want to be tied down.
I distanced myself from everything that tried to bind me.

At first, it was wonderful.
I felt as though all the world's wonders were mine.
New bonds, new landscapes, festivals I'd never seen before.
I thought I could live like that forever.

But...
That only took me so far.
Only... so far...?

Yes. Eventually...
That alone couldn't satisfy me anymore.
Like a thirst I could never quench...
...Why?

Heh... It took me a long time to understand why.
But the answer was simpler than I expected.
I'd just grown too fond of it all.
Fond of what?
Everything. Every single thing.
The people I met on my travels, the happy memories, the thrill of making it through tough times together.

As those moments added up...
I found I couldn't just keep passing through.
There were people I wanted to see again. Places I wanted to return to.
When they were in trouble, I wanted to help. When they were happy, I wanted to laugh with them.
And not long ago, someone pointed it out to me.

That perhaps I...
have come to love this world quite a bit.

Love...
the world?
Yes. The world, its sights, its people... even lively festivals like this.

Things I'd once have left behind without a second thought...
Had become precious to me.

And so my steps slowed...
Until, before I knew it, I'd stopped wandering.

And that's why...
you stayed?
Well, I suppose part of me is still a wanderer.

Heh, funny, isn't it?
I thought I'd wander forever. Yet here I am, with somewhere I belong.
...Still, I...
I know, "Child of the Boundary."

That friend I mentioned...
They're from Quartet, and they told me about you.
About a kind child whose body and soul rest on the boundary.

I'm not...
kind.

Heh, what did I just tell you?
Don't be so quick to decide.
How about this, then?

Let's find out.
Whether you're kind. Whether you really hate festivals, or love them.

What you truly want.
What you dislike, and what matters to you...
How do we find that out?

Simple.
We jump right in.
Starting with the festival you claim to hate.
...I don't want to.
Haha. Try it first, then tell me what you think.

Who knows? Give it a chance, like I did...
And you might meet someone wonderful.
Someone who'll open up your world and help you discover who you are.
As if someone like that exists...

Honestly.
Didn't I just tell you not to decide so quickly?

So, what will it be? I've said my piece.
The choice is yours.
I don't know.
But...
Just watching from a distance is worse.

Hehe... Fair enough.
Let's go and see, then.

But...
if it's boring, I'm leaving right away.

Of course! Let a festival expert show you how it's done!
Hehehe...

10110080.t: Haa... haa... ngh...!
...That's faster than I expected.
What is?
The seal! The talisman's power is already running out!

And it's this bad even here at the shrine...
Hmm...
Ngh...!
Hey, are you okay?
S-Stay away!
Haa... It's... too dangerous right now...
Right now, two powers are clashing inside Kouchou's body.
One is the power of the 'Red Butterfly,' given only to the Shrine Maiden of the Boundary. It purifies corrupting power and guides souls...

At the boundary...
One day, I found a scythe glowing red.

I took hold of it, as if something had drawn me to it...
From then on, the Red Butterflies were always... with me.
That was when... my duty as a shrine maiden began.
And the other one is...
...The "original power" that Kouchou buried in the distant past, awakened when an unknown energy tore through her body.

Of course, I don't know much about Kouchou's original power either...
So that's as much as I can explain!

...What's that supposed to mean?
You don't know either!

I can't tell you what I don't know!
I'm not an information broker. I can't know everything!

Though one of my associates does deal in memories...
Hehehe...
She's away from Quartet at the moment, so she won't be much help right now!

Not much we can do about that...
So is Kouchou turning into something like Shade or those aberrant spirits?
Because of that... unknown power?
At this point, she may be becoming a whole new 'anomaly,' neither human nor aberrant spirit!

And with a shrine maiden's power, too...
Hehehe... Who knows? She might even become a supernatural being...

Enough analysis.
What do we do?

Ah, right!
Well, this next part isn't up to me...
It all depends on Kouchou.

Her power as a shrine maiden and her original power...
They're trying to devour each other.
To help her recover quickly, we need to stop them fighting!
The fastest way would be to give up one and keep the other!
Of course... she'll 'lose' something of equal value to the power she gives up.
What kind of nonsense is that?
Does she really have to throw something away? Can't she just keep both?

It's not that simple, my friend.
You're asking her to control two completely different powers at once...
That's no different from saying you'll keep sailing between storms and raging waves.
It's difficult enough as it is. One wrong move, and she'll only suffer more...
I don't think that's a decision for us to make.

The Red Butterfly's power has always been with her, right?
It must mean a lot to her. How can we tell her to just throw it away?

Besides, that 'original power' is part of who she is.
Why should she have to give up a part of herself?

I'm sick of all this talk about giving things up.
I'm not giving up what I want, and I'm sure not giving up what's already mine.

We won't know unless we try!
Let's at least do something!

Honestly, this is like asking me to choose between boobs and ass.
Why waste time choosing when I can grab both?

W-What?! Why are you all looking at me like that?
I'm just saying I'm too greedy to give up either one!

Whew... Well, yes.
You wouldn't be you otherwise, my friend.

Yomi, could you help us a little longer?
It seems we'll be doing this the hard way after all.

Hehehe... Don't worry.
Dan Xi will cover all the extra fees anyway, right?

Urgh...
We're saving a life here. Couldn't you give me a little discount...?
Well... Thanks to this, I've made a great connection with <:player>, so I won't take any money for today.

...?
Why did a chill suddenly run down my spine...?

R-Really?!
Whew... You do have a kind heart after all...
Hm? Whatever do you mean?
Instead, Dan Xi can test a few ritual tools for me!
No coin? Then you'll just have to pay with your body, won't you?
Eek...!

...?
What's with that reaction...?

I-It's nothing, my friend!
Whew...

Anyway... this will take a little preparation.
Kouchou, please come this way!

I made this ritual tool recently...
It helps keep corrupting power in check!
Ah... At last! The perfect owner for my creation!
W-Wait... Is this... Are these... clothes...?

All the better, don't you think?
This goes here... and then this...

Eek! N-Not there...!
That leaves everything on display...!
...What's happening? What are you doing in there?
Hmm... Knowing Yomi's sorcery, I suspect...
Phew, all ready!

Kouchou? Come on out!
Everyone's waiting, you know?
Wait, THAT'S what you meant by getting ready?!

Ahaha! Do you like it?
It's my masterpiece!
Of course, custom work like this usually comes with a rather steep price tag!
Really? How much?
Well, you see...!
...Whoa. That's insane.

That's... quite a price tag.
Even with magical blessings...
But finding the right owner for my creations matters far more to me than money!
To celebrate meeting <:player> for the first time today... I won't charge extra for this outfit either!
...Thanks... I guess?
Why have you been staring at me like that since earlier, though?
Hehehe... Think nothing of it!
Well! Now that you've seen my masterpiece, on to the next step!
And that would be...
Hyaaap!
Whoa?!

10110090.t:
Ugh, Yomi...
She just shoved me without a word of warning...
Where am I, anyway...?

Kouchou...?
Weren't we just in the shrine...?

We're inside the boundary.
Where traces of the past and faded memories scatter and disappear.

...Why did you come?
There's nothing here to see...

What?
What do you mean, "why"? I got shoved into your arms, and...
No wonder I couldn't find the other two.
Is this place... your inner world or something?
...You shouldn't have come here.

What are you talking about?
...Wait. You seem completely different. Are you really Kouchou?
I'm me.
What does that even...
...Ugh!

You're hurt.
That happened when I lost control earlier, didn't it?
Yeah. You could've been a little more careful.
It was the same before.
Before, too?
Yes. Before I received the power of the Red Butterfly—the power to guide and purify souls, I had another power...
...The power to draw in 'corruption' and make it my own.
I've always drawn aberrant spirits to me.

Maybe because I lived in the rift along the boundary, surrounded by the corrupt energy of 'the other side'...
I'm a lot like them at my core.
That's why the people around me always end up hurt.
That's why I started keeping my distance.

So I wouldn't hurt anyone...
And so I wouldn't get hurt, either.
If I let you get close, I'll hurt you too.
And I don't want that.
So please, go back.
And what happens to you if I leave?
...I will seal it away.

What Yomi said?
Give up one power, and lose something with it?
Then I won't hurt anyone.

That's just giving up.
Why can't you keep both?

I already tried.
And...  this is the result.

The Kouchou you're looking at now, <:player>... is the other 'half' I turned away from.
The Memories I sealed away with my power. Memories I couldn't forget, even if I wanted to.
I was never meant to wake up. But the aberrant spirits stirred me awake, along with the power of 'the other side'.
What exactly is that power...?
...A demon's power—the ability to tear open Rifts and sever boundaries.

That's why aberrant spirits are instinctively drawn to me.
Like butterflies to the scent of flowers...
Lured by the scent of 'this side,' drifting through me...
So you're going to seal it away?

Yes. If I'm sealed away with the demonic power, the two powers will stop clashing.
The aberrant spirits won't be drawn to me anymore, either.
Then no one else will get hurt because of me.
...And what happens to you, then?
I'll go back to sleep, just like before.

Never to wake again...
Alone, drifting through the void...
But if I seal myself away before the two halves have fully merged...

All the memories, all the moments I've gathered since then...
Might disappear again.
...You know that, and you're STILL going to give up?!
Even so... If it keeps you from getting hurt.
...If it means I won't lose anyone precious to me again.
Then it's worth it.
So I have a favor to ask, <:player>.
If I end up forgetting about you...
Will you... come talk to me again?
Still... I'm glad you came all this way for me.
Don't give me that crap.
Come on. You think I don't know you by now? That's not what you really want.
W-What...?
Dammit, I came all this way, and now you're telling me to leave?
All this nonsense just to mess with my head!

No wonder you're thinking like that! Look how drab and colorless this place is!
Put some color in here already!
I-I could do that, but...
Do it now! Right this second!
It's so gloomy I can't even get in the mood to tell you off!
There. At least I can stand to look at it now.
I've heard enough about sealing things away and giving things up...
You think that's what I came all this way to hear?

...I told you.
I already tried to control it.
This is the only way to keep anyone else from getting hurt...
What's so wrong with hurting someone?
People get hurt sometimes.
We might fight, piss each other off, even grab each other by the collar and start swinging.
Sometimes we'll sulk and not want to see each other. Sometimes we'll get so annoyed we'll kick each other in the butt.

I want that kind of relationship with you.
Don't you?

Ghost powers, your other half... Why should I care?
That's not what I'm asking.
I want to know what YOU want.

Tell me, Kouchou. What do you want?
To throw away your memories, your power, our time together... and go back to being strangers?
That's not it!
Then say it! Tell me what you really want!
Stop holding back! Say it!
I don't want to be... alone!
Good! Keep going!

I wanted to enjoy the festival with everyone!
Make lots of friends, talk and laugh, buy delicious food!

With Dan Xi and everyone in the Fairwinds Association!
With the Hundred Schools of Thought, and everyone else in Quartet!
I wanted to get close to them... To talk to them and have them talk to me, too.
Because just watching from a distance hurts so much...!
And?!

And...!
With you!
I wanted to do it again and again!!
Yeah, that's it!
...Wait, what?

I want you to do whatever you like with me, <:player>! You don't have to hold back!
Honestly, I wanted you to be even rougher!

And...! Tie me up with ropes and @$%&# me!
Then $%&...! And @#%& too...!
I want you to make a complete mess of me all night long!!

Haa... Haa...
Ah.
...U-Uh... Even I wasn't ready to hear all that...

N-No.
This is...

Wait! Hold on. Look!
You...
That power...?

...Huh?
No way... How...?

Did it wake up because you finally accepted yourself?
Like... a masochistic awakening...?
I'm not a masochist.

Oh, really?
Then you don't want any of that stuff you just asked for?
I do.
There we go. A little honesty.

Anyway, what just happened?
That golden light earlier...
I... don't know. But the moment I admitted what I wanted, it felt like something inside me broke free...

It looks just like the power that changed your body earlier...
Don't tell me...
(Is this... the power of Aura? Ami never said it could do anything like this...)
More importantly, if you can control your power now, isn't the problem solved? Let's hurry and share this good news with the others outside.

Wait.
...Can't we stay a little longer?
Why? What is it?

This is my inner world...
I can do anything I like here...
Anything you want...
...Can we go inside the shrine here, too?

...Yeah.
There's bedding, too...
And some... other things, too.

10110100.t: ...Ah, you've got to be kidding me.

Just when I thought we'd sorted everything out...
What is all this?!
The boundary... collapsed...?

And aberrant spirits are wandering around like they own the place.
What is the Chrysanthemum Clan doing? Where are Chise and Kage?

Chise! There you are! I was worried.
What's going on?
Fixer...
Please... give...
What? Give you what?
Please... give me your... [■■■]...
<:player>!
Stay out of my way...

Whoa! That's cold! Chise, what are you doing?!
Trying to put me in cryogenic storage?!
That... might be nice, too...

Something's wrong with her.
She even sounds like that Shade woman...
Mmm... Oho, this is...

...Aberrant spirits have latched onto them.
Every single person here!

Seriously?!
Chise is possessed?!

Impossible. Chise is a one-woman army.
Aberrant spirits couldn't overpower her.

Fixer... Haa...
Fixer, Fixer, Fiiixer...♡

Somewhere no one can get between us, Fixer...
A festival for just the two of us...

...Then explain this!
She's never been this kind of character!
...I think she's always been a little like this, underneath it all.

Easy for you to say!
You're one to talk!
I'm... not that bad.
Seriously... Unbelievable.
All right, enough chatter.
Just as Dan Xi said, it doesn't look like Chise was done in by an aberrant spirit.
It's more like... she's choosing to keep them around.
Choosing to keep them around?!
She's playing with them... with the children...

Hmm...
You've grown so much...

Hehehe... What a relief. You're still incomplete, but...
You're growing beautifully...
...I can control both my powers now.
This time, I can beat you...
I don't intend to fight...
As I said... we're only playing...
Halloween night, when the boundary wavers...

For one night's festival, even those long forgotten...
shall rise again...

!?
What is this?!

You've waited so long, everyone...
Through long nights and days of hunger and exhaustion...
